zh-CN.title: 猫咪头像框动画恢复
items: 修复样式优先级导致 Niko 与 Fufu 头像框动画被隐藏的问题
钻出、挥手或击掌、退回消失的完整 8 帧链路恢复展示
动画仍保持每 10 秒播放一次

en.title: Cat avatar greetings restored
items: Fixed a style-specificity issue that hid the Niko and Fufu avatar-frame animations
The complete eight-frame peek, wave or high-five, and retreat sequence is visible again
The greeting continues to play once every 10 seconds
